# ShopSphere Global: Project Data Pack

## Important dates

| Item | Date |
|---|---|

| **Data snapshot (cutoff)** | **2024-09-30**. All history tables end here |
| Prediction window for `target` | 2024-10-01 to 2024-10-30 |
| Retention budget period | Weeks starting 2024-10-07 to 2024-12-30 |

`target = 1` means the customer made at least one purchase in the prediction window.

## Files

### Core tables (Kaggle structure)

| File | Rows | One row per | Key columns |
|---|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|---|

geo_ip_region; average_income; urban_ratio; internet_penetration; region_tier.

transaction_id; line_no; product_id; quantity; unit_price (list price before any order discount).

product_id; category; product_name; unit_price; margin_pct; stock_on_hand (at the cutoff); next_restock_date (blank if not scheduled); is_promotable (Yes/No).

### deliveries.csv
transaction_id; carrier; shipping_speed; ship_date; promised_date; delivered_date (blank if lost or still in transit); delay_days; delivery_status (Delivered, Delivered Late, Lost, Returned, In Transit).

### support_tickets.csv
ticket_id; customer_id; transaction_id (blank if the ticket is not about a specific order); created_date; channel (inconsistent spellings); category; priority (High, Medium, Low); status (Open, Closed at the cutoff); first_response_hours; resolution_hours (blank if open); csat_score (1–5, blank if the customer did not respond); message (the customer's first message).

### customer_preferences.csv
customer_id; email_opt_in (Y/N); sms_opt_in (Y/N); preferred_channel; preferred_language; do_not_contact (Y/N); last_updated.

### campaign_daily_performance.csv
campaign_id; date; spend; impressions; clicks; attributed_sessions; attributed_orders; attributed_revenue. Attribution model: an order is attributed to a campaign when the customer placed it on the same day as a session that came from that campaign.

### retention_contact_history.csv
contact_id; customer_id; contact_date; channel; offer_code; purchased_within_14d (Y/N); redeemed (Y/N, or n/a when no incentive was offered); redemption_date.

### offer_catalogue.csv
offer_code; description; offer_type; value (percentage for vouchers, dollars for other offers); eligible_tiers; counts_toward_monthly_limit; requires_promotable_items.

week_start (Monday); country (US, UK, DE, FR, IN); retention_budget_usd.

pd.set_option('display.width', 220); pd.set_option('display.max_columns', 60)

root = r"C:\NYP\VisualStudio\Testing ground"
p2 = os.path.join(root, "ShopSphere_DataPack_Part2_other_tables")
p1 = os.path.join(root, "ShopSphere_DataPack_Part1_sessions")

def rd(*a, **k): return pd.read_csv(*a, low_memory=False, **k)

cus = rd(os.path.join(p2,"customers.csv"))
ses = rd(os.path.join(p1,"sessions.csv"))
tr = rd(os.path.join(p2,"transactions.csv"))
ti = rd(os.path.join(p2,"transaction_items.csv"))
pr = rd(os.path.join(p2,"products.csv"))
dl = rd(os.path.join(p2,"deliveries.csv"))
st = rd(os.path.join(p2,"support_tickets.csv"))

rc = rd(os.path.join(p2,"retention_contact_history.csv"))
trn = rd(os.path.join(p2,"train.csv"))
tst = rd(os.path.join(p2,"test.csv"))
ss = rd(os.path.join(p2,"sample_submission.csv"))

print("### KEY UNIQUENESS")
for name, df, key in [("customers",cus,"customer_id"),("sessions",ses,"session_id"),
                      ("transactions",tr,"transaction_id"),("items",ti,None),
                      ("products",pr,"product_id"),("deliveries",dl,"transaction_id"),
                      ("tickets",st,"ticket_id"),("prefs",cp,"customer_id"),
                      ("campaigns",mc,"campaign_id"),("contacts",rc,"contact_id")]:
    if key:
        print(name, key, "dup keys:", int(df[key].duplicated().sum()), "rows", len(df), "unique", df[key].nunique())

print("\n### CUSTOMERS")
print("age values:", sorted(cus['age'].astype(str).unique(), key=lambda x: (x=='unknown', x))[:10], "...")
age_num = pd.to_numeric(cus['age'], errors='coerce')
print("age numeric describe:", age_num.describe().to_dict())
print("age unknown:", int((cus['age']=='unknown').sum()))
print("signup range:", cus['signup_date'].min(), cus['signup_date'].max())
print("avg_review_score >5:", int((cus['avg_review_score']>5).sum()), " <1:", int((cus['avg_review_score']<1).sum()))
print("loyalty out 0-1:", int(((cus.loyalty_score<0)|(cus.loyalty_score>1)).sum()))
print("discount out 0-1:", int(((cus.discount_usage_rate<0)|(cus.discount_usage_rate>1)).sum()))
print("email_open out 0-1:", int(((cus.email_open_rate<0)|(cus.email_open_rate>1)).sum()))
print("regions in geo:", cus.region.isin(rd(os.path.join(p2,"geo_data.csv")).geo_ip_region).all())
print("tier nulls:", cus.customer_tier.isna().sum())

print("\n### SESSIONS")

print("dur describe:", ses.session_duration.describe(percentiles=[.5,.9,.99,.999]).to_dict())
print("dur > 4h:", int((ses.session_duration>14400).sum()), ">24h:", int((ses.session_duration>86400).sum()))
print("pages max/percentiles:", ses.pages_viewed.describe(percentiles=[.99,.999]).to_dict())

print("bounce_flag crosstab:"); print(ses.bounce_flag.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())

print("ov <=0:", int((tr2.ov<=0).sum()))
print("high_value mismatch (ov>250 vs flag):", int(((tr2.ov>250) != (tr2.high_value_flag=='Yes')).sum()))
print("ts range:", tr.transaction_timestamp.min(), tr.transaction_timestamp.max())
print("dup transaction_id rows detail:", tr.duplicated('transaction_id').sum())
print("full dup rows:", tr.duplicated().sum())
d = tr[tr.duplicated('transaction_id', keep=False)].sort_values('transaction_id')
print(d.head(6).to_string())
print("cust not in customers:", int((~tr.customer_id.isin(cus.customer_id)).sum()))
print("items_count <=0:", int((tr.items_count<=0).sum()), "max", tr.items_count.max())

print("\n### TRANSACTION ITEMS")
print("qty<=0:", int((ti.quantity<=0).sum()), "unit price <=0:", int((ti.unit_price<=0).sum()))
print("product not in products:", int((~ti.product_id.isin(pr.product_id)).sum()))
print("line dup (tid,line):", int(ti.duplicated(['transaction_id','line_no']).sum()))
# price consistency vs products
pm = ti.merge(pr[['product_id','unit_price']], on='product_id', suffixes=('','_prod'))
print("unit_price mismatch vs products >0.01:", int((abs(pm.unit_price-pm.unit_price_prod)>0.01).sum()))
# lines count vs items_count
agg = ti.groupby('transaction_id').agg(qty=('quantity','sum'), nlines=('line_no','count'), maxline=('line_no','max')).reset_index()
m = tr.merge(agg, on='transaction_id', how='left')
print("txn missing items:", int(m.qty.isna().sum()), "items_count != qty:", int((m.items_count!=m.qty).sum()))
print("line_no non-contiguous:", int((agg.nlines!=agg.maxline).sum()))

print("\n### DELIVERIES")
print("status vs delivered_date missing:")
print(dl.assign(has=dl.delivered_date.notna()).groupby('delivery_status').has.value_counts().to_string())
print("delay_days by status:")
print(dl.groupby('delivery_status').delay_days.describe().to_string())
print("ship<delivered violations:", int((pd.to_datetime(dl.delivered_date)>pd.to_datetime(dl.ship_date)).sum()==len(dl)))
print("delivered before ship:", int((pd.to_datetime(dl.delivered_date)<pd.to_datetime(dl.ship_date)).sum()))

print("txn dup:", int(dl.transaction_id.duplicated().sum()))

print("\n### SUPPORT TICKETS")
print("channel counts:", st.channel.value_counts().to_dict())
print("resolution<hours first response:", int((st.resolution_hours < st.first_response_hours).sum()))
print("open but resolution not null:", int(((st.status=='Open') & st.resolution_hours.notna()).sum()))
print("closed but resolution null:", int(((st.status=='Closed') & st.resolution_hours.isna()).sum()))
print("csat out 1-5:", int(((st.csat_score<1)|(st.csat_score>5)).sum()))
print("txn not in transactions:", int((st.transaction_id.notna() & ~st.transaction_id.isin(tr.transaction_id)).sum()))
print("cust not in customers:", int((~st.customer_id.isin(cus.customer_id)).sum()))

print("\n### PREFS")

print("last_updated range:", cp.last_updated.min(), cp.last_updated.max())

print("\n### CAMPAIGNS")

print("planned end<cutoff:", int(((mc.status=='Planned') & (pd.to_datetime(mc.end_date)<pd.Timestamp('2024-09-30'))).sum()))
print("budget parse nulls:", pd.to_numeric(mc.campaign_budget.astype(str).str.replace(r'[$,]','',regex=True),errors='coerce').isna().sum())

print("\n### RETENTION CONTACT")

print("\n### TRAIN/TEST/SUB")

print("price<=0:", int((pr.unit_price<=0).sum()))

print("\n### OFFER")

"""
ShopSphere Global - data cleaning script.

Reads the raw CSV data pack and writes cleaned copies to ./cleaned_data,
plus a markdown report describing every change that was made.

Usage:
    py clean_shopsphere.py

The raw files are never modified.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from datetime import datetime

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
P1 = os.path.join(BASE, "ShopSphere_DataPack_Part1_sessions")
P2 = os.path.join(BASE, "ShopSphere_DataPack_Part2_other_tables")
OUT = os.path.join(BASE, "cleaned_data")

TRUE_VALUES = {"true", "yes", "y", "1", "t"}
FALSE_VALUES = {"false", "no", "n", "0", "f"}

ACTIONS: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
SUMMARY: list[dict] = []


def log(table: str, message: str) -> None:
    ACTIONS.setdefault(table, []).append(message)
    print(f"[{table}] {message}")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Generic helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def parse_date(series: pd.Series, table: str, column: str) -> pd.Series:
    """Parse an ISO date column, reporting any unparseable non-null values."""
    parsed = pd.to_datetime(series, errors="coerce", format="%Y-%m-%d")
    bad = int((series.notna() & parsed.isna()).sum())
    if bad:
        log(table, f"{column}: {bad:,} unparseable date values set to missing.")
    return parsed.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def parse_money(series: pd.Series, table: str, column: str) -> pd.Series:
    """Strip '$' and thousands separators, then convert to float."""
    cleaned = series.astype("string").str.replace(r"[\$,]", "", regex=True).str.strip()
    out = pd.to_numeric(cleaned, errors="coerce")
    bad = int((series.notna() & out.isna()).sum())
    if bad:
        log(table, f"{column}: {bad:,} non-numeric money values set to missing.")
    return out


def to_bool01(series: pd.Series, table: str, column: str) -> pd.Series:
    """Normalise the many boolean encodings to nullable integers 0/1."""
    lowered = series.astype("string").str.strip().str.lower()
    mapping = {**{v: 1 for v in TRUE_VALUES}, **{v: 0 for v in FALSE_VALUES}}
    out = lowered.map(mapping).astype("Int64")
    bad = int((series.notna() & out.isna()).sum())
    if bad:
        log(table, f"{column}: {bad:,} unrecognised boolean values set to missing.")
    return out


def drop_exact_duplicates(df: pd.DataFrame, table: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    n = int(df.duplicated().sum())
    if n:
        df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
        log(table, f"Removed {n:,} exact duplicate rows.")
    return df


def drop_noise_columns(df: pd.DataFrame, table: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    noise = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith("noise_")]
    if noise:
        df = df.drop(columns=noise)
        log(table, f"Dropped {len(noise)} system/noise columns: {', '.join(noise)}.")
    return df


def report_missing(series: pd.Series, table: str, column: str, note: str = "") -> None:
    n = int(series.isna().sum())
    if n:
        suffix = f" ({note})" if note else ""
        log(table, f"{column}: {n:,} missing values left as blank{suffix}.")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Table cleaners
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def clean_customers(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    t = "customers.csv"

    age_text = df["age"].astype("string").str.strip()
    n_unknown = int(age_text.str.lower().eq("unknown").sum())
    df["age"] = pd.to_numeric(age_text.replace({"unknown": pd.NA}), errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    log(t, f"age: converted {n_unknown:,} 'unknown' values to missing and cast to integer.")

    country_map = {
        "u.s.": "US", "usa": "US", "us": "US",
        "uk": "UK", "gb": "UK", "united kingdom": "UK",
        "de": "DE", "germany": "DE",
        "fr": "FR", "france": "FR",
        "in": "IN", "india": "IN",
    }
    raw_country = df["country_code"].astype("string").str.strip()
    normalised = raw_country.str.lower().map(country_map)
    unmapped = int(normalised.isna().sum())
    df["country_code"] = normalised.fillna(raw_country.str.upper())
    log(t, f"country_code: standardised inconsistent spellings to US/UK/DE/FR/IN ({unmapped:,} unmapped left upper-cased).")

    df["signup_date"] = parse_date(df["signup_date"], t, "signup_date")
    df["credit_limit"] = parse_money(df["credit_limit"], t, "credit_limit")

    out_of_range = int(((df["avg_review_score"] < 1) | (df["avg_review_score"] > 5)).sum())
    df.loc[(df["avg_review_score"] < 1) | (df["avg_review_score"] > 5), "avg_review_score"] = np.nan
    log(t, f"avg_review_score: {out_of_range:,} values outside 1-5 set to missing.")

    report_missing(df["email_open_rate"], t, "email_open_rate", "left missing, not imputed")
    df = drop_noise_columns(df, t)
    return df


def clean_sessions(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    t = "sessions.csv"

    df["session_timestamp"] = parse_date(df["session_timestamp"], t, "session_timestamp")
    df["bounce_flag"] = to_bool01(df["bounce_flag"], t, "bounce_flag")

    df["traffic_source"] = df["traffic_source"].astype("string").str.strip().str.lower()
    unknown_sources = sorted(set(df["traffic_source"].dropna()) - {"organic", "direct", "ads", "email", "social"})
    log(t, "traffic_source: lower-cased to organic/direct/ads/email/social"
        + (f" (unexpected values: {unknown_sources})." if unknown_sources else "."))

    df["device_type"] = df["device_type"].astype("string").str.strip().str.lower()
    log(t, "device_type: lower-cased to mobile/desktop/tablet.")

    n_no_campaign = int(df["campaign_id"].isna().sum())
    df["campaign_id"] = df["campaign_id"].astype("Int64")
    log(t, f"campaign_id: kept blank for {n_no_campaign:,} sessions that did not come from a campaign.")

    n_too_long = int((df["session_duration"] > 86_400).sum())
    df.loc[df["session_duration"] > 86_400, "session_duration"] = np.nan
    log(t, f"session_duration: {n_too_long:,} values above 24 hours (86,400 s) set to missing as implausible.")

    n_neg = int((df["session_duration"] <= 0).sum())
    if n_neg:
        df.loc[df["session_duration"] <= 0, "session_duration"] = np.nan
        log(t, f"session_duration: {n_neg:,} zero/negative values set to missing.")

    df["pages_viewed"] = pd.to_numeric(df["pages_viewed"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    report_missing(df["pages_viewed"], t, "pages_viewed", "left missing, not imputed")
    df["cart_additions"] = df["cart_additions"].astype("Int64")
    return df


def clean_transactions(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    t = "transactions.csv"

    df["transaction_timestamp"] = parse_date(df["transaction_timestamp"], t, "transaction_timestamp")
    df["order_value"] = parse_money(df["order_value"], t, "order_value")

    n_nonpositive = int((df["order_value"] <= 0).sum())
    df.loc[df["order_value"] <= 0, "order_value"] = np.nan
    log(t, f"order_value: {n_nonpositive:,} values of $0.00 (with positive item counts) set to missing.")

    df["discount_applied"] = to_bool01(df["discount_applied"], t, "discount_applied")

    expected_high = (df["order_value"] > 250).astype("Int64")
    mismatch = int(((expected_high.fillna(-1) != df["high_value_flag"].map({"Yes": 1, "No": 0}).astype("Int64").fillna(-1))).sum())
    df["high_value_flag"] = expected_high
    log(t, f"high_value_flag: recomputed from order_value (> $250); {mismatch:,} rows now differ from the raw flag.")

    df["items_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["items_count"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    df = drop_noise_columns(df, t)
    return df
